'''2012 SoCal Grand Prix Jan Westergard LS There Is Good In Him''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jan Westergard]] at [[2012 SoCal Grand Prix]] (Grand Prix).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him|DS2-L-thereisgoodinhim.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Grand Prix
